top_violation_types.title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Multiple infants were observed in bucket chairs without the provided straps being used.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A television was not anchored to the table it was sitting on.

top_violation_types.title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current gas inspection on file.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two out of five children records did not contain the required emergency medical authorization.

top_violation_types.title: Caregiver Required Annual Training-Caring for children younger than 24 months (26 TAC §747.1305(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Recite: The Director and Caregiver lacked current SIDS/Shaken Baby training.

top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver in a Registered Home Qualifications-Proof of Training in Required Topics (A-L) (26 TAC §747.1007(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Provider did not have documentation of all required trainings at time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian (26 TAC §747.3703(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Primary caregiver is lacking a statement of health from a local veterinarian.
